title: Riebeckite dataset link record
description: One record per line of links.ndjson, emitted by @riebeckite/plugin-dataset. Both ends are pages that appear in pages.ndjson.

sourceSlug.description: Internal slug of the linking page.

sourcePermalink.description: Published URL path of the linking page.

targetSlug.description: Internal slug of the linked page.

targetPermalink.description: Published URL path of the linked page.

raw.description: Original wiki link text, for example [[note]] or ![[note]].

embed.description: True when the link is an embed (![[...]]).
